Xi Jinping and Donald Trump Discuss AI Control

Chinese President Xi Jinping stated that the United States and China can ensure artificial intelligence (AI) development remains under human control and serves the people. This discussion occurred during a meeting with then-US President Donald Trump, who had also placed AI at the forefront of their bilateral agenda. AI executives also emphasized the importance of 'human control' over AI development.
